headline: Fresh SaaS and consumer breaches at RingCentral, Beacon CRM, and ShipMonk lead a day thick with new macOS malware, an unpatched GeoServer zero-day, and a router-hijacking botnet.

emerging_trends.text: A new Mirai-based botnet called Evooo1Bot conscripts internet-facing routers into SOCKS5 relay nodes, extending a pattern of criminals renting out compromised gateways to launder their traffic.
Exposed cloud keys and third-party providers drove today's breaches, from a leaked AWS access key behind Beacon CRM to ShinyHunters' theft of 1.6 million RingCentral records.
Attackers are crowding onto macOS, pairing the new Rust-based AmnesiaStealer with active exploitation of a passwordless Screen Sharing bug that hands over full control of a Mac.

topics.title: Evooo1Bot Router Botnet
topics.latest_developments: BleepingComputer detailed Evooo1Bot, a new modular Mirai-based Linux botnet that infects internet-facing gateway devices and converts them into SOCKS5 traffic-relay nodes.
topics.summary: The botnet rents compromised routers as proxies to anonymize criminal traffic; operators should patch gateway firmware, change default credentials, and block unsolicited inbound connections.

sources.title: New Evooo1Bot Linux botnet turns routers into traffic relay nodes

topics.title: RingCentral and SaaS Breach Wave
topics.latest_developments: The ShinyHunters extortion crew published personal data on 1.6 million RingCentral accounts stolen in a July hack, a compromised AWS access key exposed in public JavaScript build artifacts spilled records across more than 1,000 charities running Beacon CRM, and a breach at logistics provider ShipMonk exposed 14,000 Trezor hardware-wallet customers.
topics.summary: The three incidents leaked names, addresses, email addresses, and phone numbers through stolen credentials and third-party providers; affected users should expect targeted phishing, and operators should rotate any cloud keys exposed in build artifacts.

sources.title: RingCentral data breach exposed info of 1.6 million accounts
1.6 Million Likely Impacted by RingCentral Data Breach
Over 1,000 Charities Hit by Beacon CRM Data Breach
14,000 Trezor Customers Impacted by Data Breach at ShipMonk

topics.title: AmnesiaStealer and macOS Threats
topics.latest_developments: SecurityWeek detailed AmnesiaStealer, a new Rust-based macOS infostealer that harvests passwords, keychain secrets, Chromium browser data, and Safari cookies, while Ars Technica reported active exploitation of a macOS Screen Sharing flaw that lets remote attackers log in without a password and seize full control of a Mac.
topics.summary: The two threats hit Mac users through malware and an authentication-bypass bug; users should update macOS, avoid untrusted installers, and disable Screen Sharing where they do not need it.

sources.title: AmnesiaStealer macOS Malware Steals Data, Controls Browser Sessions
Vulnerability giving attackers full control of Macs is under active exploitation

topics.title: Cybercrime Crackdowns Widen
topics.latest_developments: Ukrainian police raided 94 fraudulent call centers in a nationwide operation of more than 400 searches, seizing $2 million and thousands of computers, phones, and SIM cards, while a US court sentenced a former Brightly Software contractor to two years in prison for a $2.5 million data-theft extortion scheme.
topics.summary: The call centers impersonated bank employees and pushed fake investment and cryptocurrency schemes; the twin actions show law enforcement pressing both organized fraud rings and insider extortionists.

sources.title: Ukrainian police raid 94 fraudulent call centers, seize $2 million
Data analyst sent to prison for stealing data, extorting employer

topics.title: GeoServer Zero-Day Under Attack
topics.latest_developments: Hackers are exploiting an unpatched SQL-injection zero-day in GeoServer, the open-source geospatial server, to reach remote code execution before any fix exists.
topics.summary: GeoServer powers mapping and location services for many governments and enterprises; administrators should restrict internet exposure and watch for exploitation until a patch ships.

sources.title: Hackers Exploiting Unpatched GeoServer Zero-Day

topics.title: HoneyMyte Adds Kernel Rootkit
topics.latest_developments: Kaspersky's Securelist found a new variant of the HoneyMyte espionage group's CoolClient backdoor carrying a kernel-mode rootkit driver that hides malicious processes, files, and network connections from security tools and analysts.
topics.summary: HoneyMyte, a China-linked APT, uses CoolClient for long-term access; the rootkit deepens its stealth and raises the detection bar for targeted organizations.

sources.title: APT group HoneyMyte upgrades CoolClient: the backdoor gets a kernel-level Windows rootkit

business_politics.title: Iran War Becomes a Contest of Economic Endurance
business_politics.latest_developments: President Trump today dismissed reports of food shortages and broken toilets aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln and vowed to extend its Middle East deployment as "not nearly long enough," hardening a standoff that now turns on which side buckles first under economic pressure.
business_politics.summary: The Trump administration is doubling down on sanctions and a naval blockade of Iran while Tehran bets that high oil prices will force Washington to relent, keeping the Strait of Hormuz contested and crude markets on edge; reports of poor conditions aboard the carrier USS Abraham Lincoln have drawn demands from lawmakers and sailors' families for answers.

sources.title: The Iran War Is Now About Who Blinks First Under Economic Pressure

around_town.title: Monessen Delays School Year Over Fungal Growth
around_town.latest_developments: The Monessen City School District set a new first day of Tuesday, September 8, after air-quality tests confirmed fungal growth on water-damaged building materials, expanding on the earlier discovery of "abnormalities" behind the walls.
around_town.summary: The Monessen City School District in Westmoreland County pushed back the start of its school year to September 8 after routine summer maintenance turned up fungal growth on water-damaged materials in two bathrooms, an office area, and the concession room of its middle-high school building, prompting building-wide air-quality testing.

sources.title: Monessen School District delays start of school year after discovering "abnormalities" in building walls
Monessen delays start of school year after 'fungal growth' found in water-damaged building

around_town.title: Indiana Township Rejects Housing Development
around_town.latest_developments: Indiana Township supervisors voted down a contested housing development, ending the proposal after resident opposition.
around_town.summary: The board of supervisors in Indiana Township, Allegheny County, rejected plans for a new housing development that had drawn organized opposition from residents.

sources.title: Indiana Township supervisors vote down controversial housing development plans

around_teams.title: Film Study Flags Fautanu and the Line
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette's film review of Thursday's preseason opener graded right tackle Troy Fautanu and the offensive line, finding they left "a lot to clean up."
around_teams.summary: Breaking down the Steelers' 28-9 preseason win over the Green Bay Packers, the Post-Gazette wrote that Troy Fautanu and the offensive line showed breakdowns in pass protection and the run game that leave "a lot to clean up" before the opener.

around_teams.title: Khan's First Draft Class Anchors the Roster
around_teams.latest_developments: The Post-Gazette assessed general manager Omar Khan's first Steelers draft class as a foundation to build around, days after Keeanu Benton signed a five-year extension.
around_teams.summary: The Post-Gazette wrote that Steelers general manager Omar Khan's first draft class—headlined by defensive tackle Keeanu Benton, the 2023 second-round pick who just agreed to a five-year, $73.75 million deal—has become a core the team can build the roster around.

team_usa.latest_developments: United States internationals Sergiño Dest and Ricardo Pepi combined for the winning goal to give PSV Eindhoven its first Dutch league victory of the season Saturday.
team_usa.summary: USMNT teammates Sergiño Dest and Ricardo Pepi linked up for the decisive goal as PSV Eindhoven beat Excelsior for their first Eredivisie win of the 2026-27 season on Saturday, August 15.

reading.title: Anthropic’s Watermarking, How It (Probably) Works, Worse Than It Seems
reading.summary: Ben Thompson argues that Anthropic's move to watermark AI-generated output in response to the European Union's AI law is a bad idea, flawed first on philosophical grounds and weaker in practice than it appears.

reading.author: Ed Zitron
reading.title: Premium: How Much Money Does AI Need?
reading.summary: Zitron tallies the staggering scale of capital the AI industry must keep raising to sustain its buildout and argues the demands are outrunning any plausible revenue to justify them.

reading.author: Cal Newport
reading.title: On AI Coding and Its Discontents
reading.summary: Newport uses a senior Silicon Valley engineer's turn from AI skeptic to convert to examine what AI-assisted coding actually delivers and where its limits and frustrations lie.
